verdicts.tldr: link's two arguments are never independent; one parameter renders the same bytes
verdicts.details: comment.go:29 declares link := func(urlPath, label string); every call site passes urlOf(r), r -- lines 44, 63 and 80, three of three. The pair is derivable, so the signature admits a mismatched call that no caller makes, and each site costs the reader a check that the two arguments agree. Isolating the rewrite from the finder's bundled patch, link := func(pkgPath string) computing urlOf(pkgPath) inside renders byte-identical output across all five plan shapes and three baseURL shapes. Line counts: file 196 -> 196, closure 6 -> 6, so the gain is the narrowed signature, not length. Fix: take pkgPath alone and call urlOf inside the closure.
verdicts.evidence: Isolated edit in a scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2 (candidate #90 NOT applied): 3 call sites rewritten; gofmt -l clean, go vet clean, go test -run TestRefactorGolden ./... -> 'ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview 0.002s'. wc -l comment.go 196 before and 196 after; the closure block is 6 lines both ways. Non-vacuity probe: replacing urlOf(pkgPath) with pkgPath in the rewritten closure gives '--- FAIL: TestRefactorGolden (0.00s)', so the golden digest does bind this path.

verdicts.tldr: isSeed spends six lines and a backwards argument order on one boolean and
verdicts.details: comment.go:157 declares func isSeed(pkgPath string, p *Plan) bool with a free-function receiver last and an early return, called once, at line 69. Plan's other predicates are methods -- plan.go:91 func (p *Plan) Empty() and plan.go:94 func (p *Plan) Mode() -- and gnowebSeedRealms is Plan's own concept, set from plan.go:264. Isolating the rewrite from the finder's bundled patch, func (p *Plan) isSeed(pkgPath string) bool returning p.Gnoweb && contains(gnowebSeedRealms, pkgPath) renders byte-identical output. Line counts: func 6 -> 3, file 196 -> 193. Fix: move the predicate onto *Plan and collapse the early return into one &&.
verdicts.evidence: Isolated edit in a scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2 (candidate #89 NOT applied): gofmt -l clean, go vet clean, go test -run TestRefactorGolden ./... and the whole package suite both 'ok github.com/gnolang/gno/misc/gnopreview'. wc -l comment.go 196 -> 193. Non-vacuity probe: forcing the rewritten predicate to return false gives '--- FAIL: TestRefactorGolden (0.00s)', so the seed filter is exercised -- the golden's Gnoweb:true fixture carries gno.land/r/gnoland/home in Realms, which plan.go:38 lists in gnowebSeedRealms.

verdicts.verify_by: tests/b6-lines-reach-catalog-make-fix-skips-gnopreview.sh from the repo root at ecf7af0: it plants a modernizable sentinel in misc/gnopreview, runs the root pass (go fix -omitzero=false -diff ./misc/...) and the module pass CI runs, and exits 1 while only the module pass reports the diff
verdicts.tldr: the go fix job's own instruction, make fix from the repo root, cannot reach the new module
verdicts.details: misc/gnopreview/go.mod:1 makes the directory its own module, and ci-dir-misc.yml:44 adds gnopreview to the matrix calling _ci-go.yml, whose 'Verify go fix has been applied' step (_ci-go.yml:49-70) runs GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.1 CGO_ENABLED=1 go fix -omitzero=false -diff ./... inside the module and prints "::error::'go fix' would modify files. Run 'make fix' from the repo root and commit the result." Makefile:93 runs go fix ./... in the root module, which does not descend into a nested module, and Makefile:101 lists only contribs/*/, misc/audit-pattern-harness/, misc/autocounterd/, misc/gnoe2e/, misc/loop/. Of the matrix entries with their own go.mod, gnopreview is the only one absent. Nothing is red today; the next GO_FIX_TOOLCHAIN bump that makes a modernizer fire on any file under misc/gnopreview turns that job red, and the contributor who follows the error message sees no diff and has to find the module-local incantation themselves. Fix: add misc/gnopreview/ to the loop at Makefile:101.
verdicts.evidence: Reran the finder's script from the repo root of a scratch worktree at ecf7af0f2: '   misc/gnopreview/ is NOT listed', '   go list ./misc/... packages under gnopreview: 0', '   sentinel lines in the root pass: 0', '   sentinel lines in the CI pass: 5' quoting '-func sentinelAny(v interface{}) interface{}' / '+func sentinelAny(v any) any', ending 'GAP: CI's go fix check fails on misc/gnopreview and `make fix` leaves it untouched'. Read independently: go list ./misc/... from the root returns 7 packages, 0 under gnopreview; sed -n '101p' Makefile contains no 'gnopreview'. The Makefile is not in this PR's changed files. Tree left clean (git status --porcelain: 0 lines).
